operating_rule: a satellite counts as operating on a day when it reports >= 5 vegetation detections over Argentina

bridge.unit: S-NPP-equivalent VIIRS 375 m pixels (count / g); per day, mean over operating satellites

static_rule: detections inside the static-source class (data/agg/static_cells.json, 0.02° cells) are counted in st, never in h
national_note: national = sum over the 4 193 land cells of Argentina (data/harmonized/cells.json); cells outside them (neighbouring countries, sea) are kept in `cells` but not in `national`
note: PRELIMINARY, near-real-time, month to date. Produced by scripts written with SI assistance (Claude, Anthropic); all values computed from NASA FIRMS Area API (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21; standard processing where available, NRT otherwise).
